behavior: When JDTLS_HOME is set to a directory holding no resolvable JDT LS launcher jar, resolveInstall() fails with an error that explicitly names both the JDTLS_HOME path that was checked and what specifically was missing (a resolvable org.eclipse.jdt.ls.core_* launcher jar under it) -- it is never a generic message and never a raw filesystem/stack-trace error.
rationale: The design's stated observable seam for the invalid-override failure is message content naming the path and the missing artifact, not just pass/fail [INV-PROV-3]; a fixed-content example on a directory deliberately missing the launcher jar catches an implementation that correctly fails closed but reports a generic or opaque error -- a defect TCON-PROV-0004's pass/fail-and-request-count assertion alone cannot detect.
